# Vynix MCP Server

> Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents direct access to Vynix feedback, annotations, screenshots, diagnostics, and issue workflows.

Important notes:

- Primary machine-readable registry metadata is in server.json.
- Claim metadata for Glama is in glama.json.
- Smithery metadata is in smithery.yaml.
- Install and usage instructions are in README.md.

## Core metadata

- [MCP server metadata](./server.json): Canonical MCP registry metadata, package and transport information.
- [Glama ownership metadata](./glama.json): Maintainer identities for Glama claiming.
- [Smithery metadata](./smithery.yaml): Smithery project config.

## Documentation

- [README](./README.md): Installation matrix, configuration, tools, prompts, troubleshooting.
- [Tool reference](./docs/tools.md): Read and write tools catalog.
- [Prompt reference](./docs/prompts.md): Workflow prompts catalog.
- [Resource reference](./docs/resources.md): MCP resources exposed by the server.
- [Deployment guide](./docs/deployment.md): Stdio and streamable-http deployment guidance.

## Optional

- [Prompt examples](./examples/prompts.md): 100+ realistic prompts.
- [Workflow examples](./examples/workflows/open-feedback.md): End-to-end interaction examples.
